This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be carried 
 out on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the little block.

This pump is used to transfer water from high 
 pressure drum to high pressure evaporator then to high pressure drum again.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Mostafa 
 Saada, revised by eng. Ahmed Elsaaedy, accepted by eng. Khamis Elsherif: 
 maintenance general director and approved by eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby head 
 sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This document reviewed by eng. Magdey Mahmoud Hegazy, 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; MEPC inspection & quality control general 
 director & MPIS coordinator, and certified by eng. Mohamed Nageeb inspection & 
 quality controls head sector.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued.

The 
 maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID 
 safety category.

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

The safety 
 department must check the isolation and surrounding the zone of work.

Wear the 
 safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety 
 glasses .. etc

Shutdown 
 the pump.

Disconnect 
 the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker.

Put red tag 
 on the pump.

Close the 
 shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge).

Let the 
 pumps cool down to about < 80 C measured at the branches, then seal off the 
 cooling water pipes and close all other supply lines.

Loosen all 
 auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling liquid, lube oil.
Complete maintenance tool set.
Crane.

Alignment 
 indicators, filler.
Grease gun.

Cleaning 
 fluid

Measure the 
 alignment and record it.

Measure the 
 vibration and record it.

Record the 
 discharge pressure.

Disconnect 
 the motor electrically.

Isolate the 
 pump from suction and discharge by closing the valves.

Drain pump 
 casing, bearing frame and cooling circuit.

Disconnect 
 all auxiliary circuits.

Remove 
 coupling guard.

Remove 
 coupling spacer to allow dismantling of the pump with disturbing either motor 
 or pump casing.

Loosen 
 fixing screws on back frame foot of the pump.

Unscrew 
 fixing nuts on stuffing box.

Remove the 
 assembly consisting of bearing frame and stuffing box from pump casing making 
 use of the extracting screws specially provided for this purpose.

Unscrew 
 impeller lock nut (right hand thread) (item 58).

Remove the 
 impeller.

Disconnect 
 cooling piping connected to seal cover.

There are 
 two ways to dismantle the mechanical seal :

Dismantling 
 with cover item 3 still mounted.

Dismantling 
 with cover item 3 released.

Dismantle 
 half - coupling pump side.

Loosen 
 fixation screws and remove both deflector discs ( items 9 and 23 )

Remove 
 bearing covers ( items 4 and 5 )

To dismantle 
 the bearings, strike lightly with a block of wood on shaft end impeller side 
 in order to get the shaft to slide towards coupling side ; bearings R2 and R3 
 remain on shaft ( the outer ring of bearing R2 remains in the bearing frame 
 and should be removed separately ) : the inner ring of bearing R1 remains 
 fitted on shaft and should also be removed separately.

Withdraw 
 outer rings of bearings R2 and R1 from bearing frame.

Remove 
 bearing lock nut item 92 after releasing safety washer item S3.

Withdraw 
 bearings R2 and R3. These bearings are tight-fitted on the shaft. To remove 
 them, tap with a copper drift on the inner ring or use an extractor.

Clean all 
 parts of the pump.
Change all O- rings and gaskets.

Change the 
 oil.

All wearing 
 parts must be checked before assembly and repaired or replaced if necessary .

Clean 
 cooling chamber of stuffing box after removing the cover.

Measure the 
 radial clearance for the pump and adjust them.

Inspect the 
 run out of the shaft.

Mount 
 bearings R2 and R3 on shaft.

Lock R2 and 
 R3 into place by means of bearing lock nut item 92 and fit safety washer item 
 S3 previously.

Introduce 
 shaft into bearing frame from driver side.

From 
 impeller side, slide bearing R1 on shaft and fit it into place in bearing 
 frame.

Fit bearing 
 cover driver side item 5 with its gasket item J3

Fit bearing 
 cover pump side item 4 with its gasket item J2.

Mount 
 deflector disks items 9 and 23 and tighten their fixing screws.

Fit a new 
 gasket item 4 on seal cover item 3.

Fit complete 
 stationary seal ring in cover with gasket item 1.1.2 and springs item 1.1.4 
 and place snap ring item 5.

Check smooth 
 slide and correct positioning of shaft sleeve item 2 on shaft.

Fit a new 
 graphite o-ring on shaft sleeve end.

Fit rotary 
 seal ring item 1.2 and gasket item 1.3 on shaft sleeve.

Reassemble 
 cover item 305 on stuffing box together with its o-ring items T3 and T4.

Introduce 
 the shaft protruding from the bearing frame into seal cover and stuffing box 
 and secure bearing frame item 1 to stuffing box item 83.

Carefully 
 slide shaft sleeve onto shaft, the shaft being placed horizontally.

Mount 
 impeller ( item 55 ) and impeller lock nut ( item 58 ), not forgetting o-ring 
 ( item T1 )

Care must be 
 taken to tighten the impeller lock nut properly.

Assemble the 
 complete mechanism to pump casing.

Fit frame 
 foot ( item 109 ).

Mount pump 
 back on its base frame.

Fill the 
 bearing frame with oil.

Open the 
 suction and delivery of the pump.

Record the 
 alignment.

Record the 
 discharge pressure.

Record the 
 vibration.
